P2P baby monitor: Vite + TypeScript, WebRTC (PeerJS); Baby Station streams camera/mic, Parent Station receives. Source: `src/`; e2e: `tests/`; cert scripts: `scripts/`, `certs/`; assets: `public/`. Stations use `init*` and `CleanupHandle`; URL params: `station`, `roomId`; IDs: `WordWordWord1234` (`src/dictionary.ts`).  
All stations MUST return `{ cleanup: () => void }` for proper teardown  
Use `querySelectorOrThrow()` - never silently fail on missing DOM  
Never leave MediaStream tracks running after cleanup  
Never use `querySelector` without null check (use `querySelectorOrThrow`)  
Don't hardcode PeerJS peer IDs in parent station (random ID, call by room)  
**Wake Lock**: Always request on station init, release in cleanup
